campaign: Integrated validation, phase 2: bounded capability gains and evidence-gated simplification
doctrine: Rank by fastest progress: model capability and validation first, then changes that make every later landing cheaper, then cleanup; owner-blocked and long-horizon rows last. Consolidate duplicated logic into fewer general components rather than adding instrumentation or frameworks; net AST nodes stay flat or fall, and the clone and harness ratchets hold the floor. No new model family, workflow, optimizer or orchestration framework without an owner request. A step's verify is its machine check; a check whose prerequisite cannot run records UNAVAILABLE, not a pass. depends_on names real producers. GUI and audio keep their lanes; master runs as master-lead. docs/plan.json is the only live plan.

items.title: Load timesfm-3.0 as a forecast model of its own

steps.title: Load timesfm-3.0 as a forecast model of its own

So the complete receipt that keeps ten media and specialized models current expires on every landing and costs a four-minute rerun. Name each read at its source or route it through attributed readers; test over the real input graph and measure the input count before and after.

steps.title: Defer decoding large store facets until first use, if opens are still slow
steps.rationale: Re-measure first, after the other store rows shrink the facets. 2026-09-22: a read-only open is 1.7 s, bounded by the largest decode (lineage 88.3 MB of 189 MB), with verification about 0.1 s. Laziness inside the facet fails (value receivers) and re-replaying the journal fails (shared file cursor). Defer at the store, which owns the lock: keep the verified payload and pending commits, apply on first load behind a double-checked write lock, and test that a deferred facet answers exactly as an eager one.

items.title: Recover small-head decode throughput without losing long-context correctness

steps.title: Recover small-head decode throughput without losing long-context correctness

Compare isolated before/after runs across short, 4096-boundary, tile-boundary and long contexts. Keep split-key correctness, NLL and memory; bind kernel parity plus end-to-end Qwen and E4B checks. Reuse the MiniCPM split derivation; no competing policy.
